verdict.rationale: Weave's marketing page says alerts tied to built-in and custom signals route through Slack notifications and can trigger webhook automations, so the product has its own alerting with Slack delivery. The evidence never shows alert conditions on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops, and never mentions PagerDuty or email channels; the claim appears only on the marketing site, not in technical docs. Missing for 10: documented threshold alerts on error rate, cost, and eval scores; PagerDuty and email notification channels; first-party alerting docs and independent corroboration.
